subject: MAP: Quickstart POC — org seed, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Patel <alex.patel@heliumhealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karl_sales@heliumhealth.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart POC — environment details and ask

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move quickly on a short POC to validate Redwood's hosted inference latency and cost on our sample traffic.

Top-line ask: can Redwood stand up a pilot tenant for Helium Health with the following in scope so we can complete an eval in ~10 business days?
- org/tenant seeded in your console (we'll need an admin user and service account)
- API keys for server-side test traffic
- IP allowlist for our staging CIDR blocks
- optional VPC peering if we can get a window in the coming week

We can provide the staging IP ranges and a contact in infra. Preferred start: Wed, Mar 3. Go/no-go decision ideally by Tue, Mar 15.

Attaching the IP ranges CSV and our prelim scope doc. Let me know if you need anything else to start.

Thanks,
Alex Patel
Head of Platform, Helium Health
alex.patel@heliumhealth.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Patel <alex.patel@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart POC — environment details and ask

Hi Alex —

Great to hear you're ready to run the pilot. Below is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) we propose to hit your evaluation window. If this looks good, we'll create the HubSpot MAP card and assign owners.

Proposed MAP (high level) — timeline estimates from kickoff (target start Wed, Mar 3):
1) Org & tenant provisioning — Redwood (Irene) to create Helium tenant and seed admin user (Mar 3, EOD)
2) Service account + API keys — Redwood (Karthik) to issue service account keys and provide secure key share (Mar 4)
3) IP allowlist & baseline tests — Helium infra to confirm staging CIDRs; Redwood to add entries and run smoke tests (Mar 4–Mar 5)
4) VPC peering (optional) — exchange peering templates and schedule peering window (target Mar 8–Mar 10)
5) Run evaluation tests (latency, throughput, cost sampling) — joint runbook, 3 test scenarios (Mar 8–Mar 12)
6) Go/no-go decision & retro — Helium to confirm by Mar 15

Action items for you to confirm by EOD Tue (Mar 2):
- Confirm the staging CIDR list (or attach CSV)
- Confirm single admin contact + email for tenant seed
- Indicate whether you want us to open the VPC peering work now or keep it as a fallback (we can do API-key testing without peering).

I'll attach a compact MAP PDF and the Redwood VPC peering template once we confirm. Karthik — can you standby to issue the service account once we have the admin contact?

Best,
Irene
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
Attachment: MAP-Pilot-compact.pdf

From: DevOps Team <devops@heliumhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Alex Patel <alex.patel@heliumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart POC — environment details and ask

Irene — attaching the staging CIDRs and our tenant metadata. Quick notes:
- Staging CIDR blocks: 52.12.0.0/20, 52.12.16.0/22, 10.40.0.0/16 (see attached helium_ip_ranges.csv)
- Org id for Redwood tenant seed: helium-staging-001 (use that in the tenant label)
- Preferred peering window: Mar 9, 01:00–03:00 UTC or Mar 10, 02:00–04:00 UTC (we can confirm once your network ops team says which works)

We do prefer peering for realistic egress timings but agree api-key testing is OK to start. Please share the service-account format and a secure mechanism for key exchange (we use ephemeral S3 presigned links or Hashi Vault).

- DevOps (Helium Health)
Attachment: helium_ip_ranges.csv

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Patel <alex.patel@heliumhealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart POC — MAP and next steps (confirmed)

Thanks for the swift response and the CIDRs — that's perfect. Finalizing MAP and owners below; please reply with a single-line confirmation so we can move to execution. We'll also publish this to HubSpot and attach the artifacts.

Confirmed MAP (owners + dates):
- Tenant seed and admin invite — Irene Choi (Redwood) — target: 2027-03-03 23:59 UTC
- Service account + API keys issuance — Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — target: 2027-03-04 14:00 UTC; keys will be delivered via a presigned S3 link and rotated after test window
- IP allowlist applied & smoke tests — Neha Kapoor (Redwood) / DevOps (Helium) — target: 2027-03-04 18:00 UTC
- VPC peering template exchange & scheduling — Marissa Cole (Redwood) / DevOps (Helium) — target peering window: 2027-03-09 or 2027-03-10 (confirm by Mar 5)
- Evaluation run (3 scenarios: burst load, steady throughput, tail latency) — joint runbook — target: 2027-03-08 to 2027-03-12
- Go/no-go signoff — Alex Patel (Helium) — deadline: 2027-03-15 23:59 UTC

Attachments included in this thread: MAP-Pilot-compact.pdf, helium_ip_ranges.csv, Redwood-VPC-peering-template.docx

Next steps (for Helium):
1) Reply-all with confirm + admin email for tenant seed
2) Confirm peering window preference by EOD Fri Mar 5 (if you want peering in scope)

If confirmed, we'll spin up the tenant and Karthik will follow up in a separate secure channel to share the API keys.

Thanks — looking forward to running the pilot.

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
Phone: (650) 555-0199
